title: Sales Representative warns at the switch and Technician warns on Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, with Sales Representative on, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A, with no line that staff member A is on, so the warning has a led work order to count.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Sales Representative off.
  3. Confirm the Sales Representative removal warning.
  4. Switch Technician off.
  5. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Sales Representative on and Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The existing Sales Representative removal warning shows at once, as today.
  • No "Turn Off Technician" warning shows yet.

Step 3:

  • The removal warning closes and Sales Representative is off.

Step 4:

  • Technician is off and no warning shows yet.

Step 5:

  • The warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows, with a Cancel button and a Save button.
  • Its text reads "[staff member A's first and last name] leads 1 open work order. They'll stay on it, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."

In the warning texts, [staff member A's first and last name] stands for staff member A's name exactly as it was last saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-E3: “Turning off Sales Representative still shows its existing removal warning at the moment that toggle is switched off, as today; the Turn Off Technician warning shows only on Save. Cancelling the Turn Off Technician warning cancels the whole save, including a Sales Representative removal already confirmed, and the window stays open as the user left it.”
  • S2-R2: “When at least one work order or line is counted, a warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows. The text names the staff member as last saved (a new name typed in the same save is not used) and what they hold, for example: "Jordan Lee leads 8 open work orders and is on 50 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
